article.title: Genocide treated as afterthought by media on third anniversary of October 7 attacks
article.author: Editor
article.content: October 7 marked three years since the Hamas attacks on Israel that left some 1,200 people dead and 251 taken hostage. It also marks three years since Israel launched its genocide of Palestinians in the Gaza Strip with material and moral support from the United States, with an official death toll surpassing 74,000—including more than 20,000 children. The post Genocide treated as afterthought by media on third anniversary of October 7 attacks appeared first on MR Online .
